latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release—comprehensive Kickstarter and Indiegogo launch planning skill.

- Guides you through every step of preparing a crowdfunding campaign, from pre-launch list-building and funnel setup to reward tier structuring and fulfillment cost math.
- Offers detailed funding goal calculations using industry-standard benchmarks like the 30% rule.
- Provides templates and advice for campaign page copy and 90-second video scripting.
- Includes recommendations for landing page tools, email list growth strategies, and campaign launch-day sequencing.
- Covers ongoing campaign management, stretch goals, and post-funding best practices.
